name: The Last of Ourselves
source:
The plot develops around Ellisse, a very sexy and funny character who will tell you her story set in a post-apocalyptic world. You will find out many things in detail about her journey of discovery and sexual awakening. A secondary male character whose name you'll be able to choose will be her protector and sexual partner. 

It's a parody game based on The Last of Us.​
translation:
剧情围绕埃利斯展开，埃利斯是一个非常性感又有趣的角色，她将向你讲述她发生在后世界末日世界的故事。你会详细了解她的发现和性觉醒之旅的许多细节。一个你可以选择名字的次要男性角色将是她的保护者和性伴侣。

这是一款基于《最后生还者》的恶搞游戏。​
